Research services | revenue = {{up}} {{INRConvert|1330.41|c}} (2021) | net_income = {{up}} {{INRConvert|81.05|c}} (2021) | assets = {{up}} {{INRConvert|1593.82|c}} (2021) | equity = {{up}} {{INRConvert|802.51|c}} (2021) | num_employees = 940 (2021) | website = {{URL|http://www.praj.net/}} }} '''Praj Industries Limited''' is an Indian multinational process and project engineering company, headquartered in [[Pune]], [[Maharashtra]]. The company also has offices in [[South Africa]], [[North America]], [[Latin America]], the [[Caribbean]], [[Thailand]] and [[Philippines]]. Its manufacturing facilities are at 4 locations – in [[Sanaswadi]], near [[Pune]]; [[Kandla]], Port in [[Gujarat]] and Wada, [[Thane District]]. Praj is a recipient of the [[Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (India)|DSIR]] National Award in 2005 for outstanding In-House R&D Achievements. ==History== Praj was formed in 1983. The company went public in 1994 and is listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India]]. Praj received its first [[Venture Capital]] from [[ICICI Bank]] in 1987.{{cite web|url=https://www.edelweiss.in/stocks/Praj-Industries-Ltd/company-history/3458.html|title=Praj Industries Ltd|publisher=Edelweiss}} Today it has investors like [[venture capital]]ist [[Vinod Khosla]] who has a 10% stake{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/Vinod-Khosla-buys-10-stake-in-Praj-Industries/articleshow/1482146.cms|title=Vinod Khosla buys 10% stake in Praj Industries| newspaper=The Times of India |date=8 April 2006 | accessdate=8 April 2006}} and Marubeni Corporation.{{cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/vinod-khosla-marubeni-to-buy-stake-in-praj-inds-106041101100_1.html|title=Vinod Khosla, Marubeni to buy stake in Praj Inds|newspaper=Business Standard|accessdate=11 April 2006}} Praj Foundation was established in 2005 as the CSR wing which is managed by Parimal Chaudhari. In 2021, the company and [[Indian Oil Corporation]] signed a memorandum of understanding to explore opportunities in the production of alcohol-to-jet (ATJ) fuels, [[Ethanol biofuels|1G & 2G ethanol]], compressed [[biogas]] and other related opportunities in the [[biofuel]]s sector.{{Cite web |date=May 2022 |title=Chemical Industry, Chemicals Manufacturers and Exporters in India - IBEF |url=https://www.ibef.org/industry/chemical-industry-india |access-date=2022-06-14 |website=India Brand Equity Foundation |language=en}} ==Business divisions== The company deals with segments like Alcohol / Fuel Ethanol and Brewery Plants, Water and Wastewater Treatment Plants,{{cite web|title=Praj Industries expects water-treatment to be India business growth story | url=http://www.livemint.com/Companies/LA4DsE2TkJF9uuEIwIM81J/Praj-Industries-expects-watertreatment-to-be-India-business.html | publisher=Live Mint |accessdate=19 February 2014}} Critical Process Equipment System, High Purity Systems, BioProducts (Livestock Health and Nutrition Products), and Customised Research Service & Solutions.{{Cite journal |date=August 2021 |title=A Conversation with Dr. Pramod Chaudhari |url=https://www.liebertpub.com/doi/abs/10.1089/ind.2021.29259.pch |journal=Industrial Biotechnology |volume=17 |issue=4 |pages=185–187 |doi=10.1089/ind.2021.29259.pch |issn=1550-9087|url-access=subscription }} ==Subsidiaries and acquisitions== The company's acquisitions include – Praj HiPurity Systems Limited (erstwhile Neela Systems Ltd),{{cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/praj-acquires-neela-systems-for-rs-64-cr-112011000059_1.html|title=Praj acquires Neela Systems for Rs 64 cr|newspaper=Business Standard|accessdate=10 January 2012}}{{cite web|title=Praj acquires stake in Neela Systems|url=http://businesswireindia.com/news/news-details/praj-acquires-stake-neela-systems/29656|publisher=Business Wire India|accessdate=20 May 2016}} Praj Americas. Inc, Praj Far East Co. Ltd., Praj Industries ([[Africa]]) Pty. Ltd., Praj Far East Philippines Ltd. Inc., Praj Industries ([[Tanzania]]) Ltd. {subsidiary of Praj Industries (Africa) Pty. Ltd.}, Praj Industries ([[Sierra Leone]]) Ltd. (subsidiary of Praj Industries (Africa) Pty Ltd., Praj sur America SRL, Praj Engineering & Infra Ltd. ==Awards and recognition== * Praj was awarded the National Award for outstanding In-House R&D Achievements by [[Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (India)|DSIR]] in 2005.{{cite web|title=DSIR honors Praj Industries Limited with "National Award" |url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/dsir-honors-praj-industries-limitednational-award_191400.html | publisher=MoneyControl}} * Praj was awarded the "Association of Biotechnology Led Enterprises|ABLE 10th anniversary award" under bio-industrial category for contribution to industrial biotechnology.{{cite web|url=http://www.freepressjournal.in/praj-honored-with-able-award/159892|title=Praj Honored with ABLE Award|newspaper=The Free Press Journal |accessdate=14 March 2013}} * Praj Tower received ‘Platinum’ LEED Certification from IGBC.http://www.solarquarter.com/index.php/news/asia/india/item/1257-praj-tower-receives-platinum-leed-certification-from-igbc-the-highest-ranking-certificate {{Dead link|date=February 2022}} * Praj Bags B.G. Deshmukh CSR Innovation Award {{cite web|url=http://archive.indianexpress.com/news/11-bag-mccia-innovation---entrepreneurship-awards/1022168|title=11 bag MCCIA innovation & entrepreneurship awards|newspaper=The Indian Express |accessdate=26 October 2012}} * Praj received ‘Solar Energy Society of India (SESI) Business Leadership Award’ at the ICORE 2005{{cite web|url=http://www.biospectrumindia.com/biospecindia/news/158475/news-bytes-suppliers|title=News Bytes- Praj receives SESI Award |publisher=BioSpectrum |accessdate=10 May 2005}} * Praj was awarded ''Forbes Best Under A Billion Company in [[Asia]]''{{cite web|url=http://m.moneycontrol.com/news/business/praj-gets-forbes-best-under-a-billion-companyasia_316259.html|title=Praj gets Forbes Best Under A Billion Company in Asia|publisher=MoneyControl|accessdate=6 December 2007}} ==Initiatives== ===Industry innovations=== # Launched the ‘Water Master Class’ knowledge forum in [[Chennai]] that aims at sharing industry experts’ experience in water & wastewater management and treatment of complex industrial effluents.{{cite web|url=http://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-sector-breweries/praj-launches-the-water-masterclass-knowledge-forum-in-chennai-114091100118_1.html|title=Praj launches the Water Masterclass knowledge forum in Chennai|publisher=India Infoline News Service |accessdate=11 September 2014}} # Licensing and Joint Development Agreements With Gevo{{cite press release|url=https://globenewswire.com/news-release/2015/11/09/785206/0/en/Gevo-Signs-Licensing-and-Joint-Development-Agreements-With-Praj.html|title=Gevo Signs Licensing and Joint Development Agreements With Praj |date=9 November 2015 |publisher=Gevo, Inc. GlobeNewswire News Room}}{{cite web|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/praj-signs-licensing-and-joint-development-pacts-with-gevo/article7861937.ece|title=Praj signs licensing and joint development pacts with Gevo |date=9 November 2015 |publisher=The Hindu Business Line |accessdate=9 November 2015}}{{cite news|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-11-09/gevo-shares-jump-on-biofuel-investment-deal-with-india-s-praj|title=Gevo Shares Rise on Biofuel Investment Deal With Praj|author=Alex Nussbaum |work=Bloomberg.com |date=9 November 2015 |accessdate=9 November 2015}}{{cite web|url=http://smartinvestor.business-standard.com/company/cNews-cnewsdet-302622-3458-Praj_Industries_in_strategic_alliance_with_Gevo_for_producing_renewable_isobutanol-Praj_Industries_Ltd.htm#.VpzQqZp97IU|title=Praj Industries in strategic alliance with Gevo for producing renewable isobutanol |publisher=Smart Investor, Business Standard}} # Develops innovative method to produce Ethanol{{cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/praj-develops-innovative-method-to-produce-ethanol-109021000157_1.html|title=Praj develops innovative method to produce ethanol|date=10 February 2009 |publisher=Business Standard |accessdate=10 February 2009}} Matrix, the R&D Center (division of Praj Industries) is based on the foundation of scientific expertise and technology development. Located in [[Pune]] ([[India]]), Praj Matrix is organized around the 5 major Centers of Excellence. [[Molecular Biology]] and [[Microbiology]]; Bioprocess Technology Analytical Sciences; [[Chemistry|Chemical Sciences]]; and Scale up and [[Process engineering]]. It is supported by over 100 technologists including 20 PhDs.{{cite web|url=http://archive.indianexpress.com/news/praj-industries-honoured-for-work-in-biotech/482017/|title=Praj Industries honoured for work in biotech |publisher=The Indian Express |accessdate=27 June 2009}} # Introduced ‘BioWiz’ Smart Bioreactor.{{cite web|url=http://www.financialexpress.com/article/pharma/pharma-ally/praj-hipurity-systems-introduces-biowiz-smart-bioreactor/22401/|title=Praj HiPurity Systems introduces BioWiz Smart Bioreactor |publisher=Financial Express|date=23 December 2014}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Authority control}} [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Pune]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies established in 1983]] [[Category:Engineering companies of India]] [[Category:1983 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1983]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
